title: The Schrödinger equation with fluctuating nonlinearity in the energy space
summary: We study nonlinear Schrödinger equations with nonlinear Stratonovich noise \begin{equation*} \mathrm{d} u\,=\, i\bigl[ Δu \,+\, λ|u|^{p-1}u\bigr] \, \mathrm{d} t \,+\,i|u|^{(q-1)/2}u\circ \mathrm{d} {W}, \end{equation*} in their energy space $H^1(\mathbb R^d;\mathbb C)$. By combining the stochastic Strichartz estimates derived in [Potential Anal. 41 (2014), pp.\ 269--315] with the approach from [Ann.\ Inst.\ H.\ Poincaré Phys.\ Théor.\ 46 (1987), pp.\ 113--129] we obtain local well-posedness for all energy-subcritical nonlinearities $p,q\in [1, 1+4/(d-2)_+)$ together with a corresponding…
